ChurchStream is free software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**: live streaming to YouTube and Facebook plus projection of hymns, Bible readings and announcements, from one simple control panel. It runs on Windows and Mac.

## Download

| Computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** laptop or PC | **[ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.3/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1–M4) | **[ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.3/ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** | **[ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.3/ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip)** |

**Updating?** Copy the new files over your old ChurchStream folder; your **ChurchStream-data** folder (settings, songs, services) is kept. First time? See the install steps in the [README](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream#install-windows).

## New in 0.3.3: Advent Youth Sing, choruses and your own songs
- **Advent Youth Sing (AY Sing)** is now a songbook like the hymnals: type `ay 25` to open song 25, or make AY Sing the book that a plain number opens. ChurchStream doesn't include the AY text; import your church's own copy on the **Advent Youth Sing** card in Settings → Hymnals & songs.
- **Import songs…** adds many choruses and songs at once. It reads plain text and Word files (one song, or a numbered list of songs), CCLI SongSelect downloads, OpenLyrics (OpenLP), ChordPro and CSV. Choose whether they go into a songbook or "My own songs". Importing again updates them but keeps any song you've edited.
- **Take songs to another computer:** **Save to a file…** makes a `.churchsongs` file of a songbook or of your own songs. Copy it by USB stick, email or WhatsApp and open it on the other laptop with **Import songs…**.
- Projecting and streaming songs still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence online).

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use).
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
